{{Top|leg}}
A '''vibropick''' was a type of [[Lock-picking kit|lockpicking]] tool. It was considered a more archaic way to breach physical security. While most locks in the galaxy depended on an electrical component, there were places and cultures without a consistent supply of electricity. Additionally, an unexpected power loss could necessitate the manual manipulation of previously electronic locks. In these circumstances, a [[Vibropick/Legends|vibropick]] or [[laser lockpick]] became a suitable option.<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>
